BiblicalUsage: When the text says ruṭăphash, it means to be rejuvenated. It stands in Job 33:25: "His flesh shall be fresher than a child's…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put ruṭăphash here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
